items.title: RadixArk releases DaisyRose-27B, a Qwen3.8-27B tuned with RL on 1,200 agent tasks, lifting Terminal-Bench 4.1 from 5.6% to 12.0%
items.summary: Open BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 weights (55.6, 30.9 and 21.9 GB) from the SGLang team, trained in 18 days on 144 H200s with Miles; smaller gains on Terminal-Bench 2.1, DeepSWE and GPQA Diamond. Community GGUF quants (Q4_K_M 17.3 GB) fit a 24 GB card for the weights alone.

items.title: FastRUA cuts a GPT-6 Astra + Codex robot-use agent from 11.1 to 3.4 minutes on a cup task and from about 18 to 6 minutes on towel folding
items.summary: By merging tool-call round trips and running robot motion while the model plans the next actions, the real-robot agent moves 84% of the time instead of 24%. Code and a write-up are published.

items.title: Four DGX Sparks run the official 475 GiB DeepSeek V4.1 Flash checkpoint at about 88 tok/s single stream with vLLM TP=4
items.summary: A home-cluster write-up of cold prefill at 8.5K tok/s on 32K input, about 2 minutes from cold start to API, and a ring-wired network matching a switch (23.8 vs 24.1 GB/s NCCL). Two Sparks only fit a 2.8 to 2.9 bpw EXL3 build, which does 153.5 tok/s aggregate at 4 streams on TensorFold.

items.title: Nous Research brings Hermes Agent to Microsoft Teams and Azure, with each agent's work run in an isolated Azure Container Apps sandbox
items.summary: Hermes Enterprise takes delegated tasks inside Teams, saves a good routine as a skill and lets a team share reviewed skills (Collective Wisdom); it can also run in a customer's own Azure tenant. No download or docs link is in the post.

doubt.pushback: No release link, docs or hands-on results in the post; one replier notes it is not available in Teams on iOS.

reception.summary: Replies were mostly congratulations with a few worries about corporate involvement; nobody reports having tried it.

items.title: OpenAI Responses API now ties each GPT-6.2 reasoning item to the history before it, so editing earlier messages drops the reasoning that follows
items.summary: For agents on the newest frontier models, reasoning is kept and cache hits rise when history is append-only; trimming, rewriting or locally summarizing earlier turns forces the model to redo that reasoning. Builders who manage their own context need to re-check their harness.

doubt.pushback: A roster account reads the change as a reasoning-protection measure rather than a pure efficiency gain, and repliers point out that local compaction or changing tools counts as an edit, so some harnesses will lose the savings.

reception.summary: Repliers mostly restated the append-only rule and worried about compaction and trimming; a few noted opencode needs native compaction to keep reasoning, and nobody posted measured results.

security_na.reason: GB10 unified-memory cudaMalloc is not charged to Docker --memory or cgroup limits (DGX Spark OOM freeze behavior, NVIDIA forum report): a resource-accounting limitation, not a vulnerability or compromise; noted for Spark awareness only.
